prompt: launch video for a note-taking app

plan.title: Meet Notely: Notes That Find You Back
plan.description: A launch video for a note-taking app that helps you capture ideas fast and find them again. See how capture, organize and search work in three simple steps.

beats.narration: You had a great idea last week. You wrote it down somewhere. A sticky note, a random document, a message to yourself. Now where is it? Why can't you find it?

props.clip_query: person searching through papers on desk
clip_queries: person searching through papers on desk
props.alt: frustrated person looking at messy desk

beats.narration: Notes scatter across apps, notebooks and scraps of paper. The more you write, the harder it gets to find anything. Good thinking gets buried, and then it is simply lost.
So we built Notely. One calm place for everything you want to remember. It opens fast, it stays out of your way, and it helps you find your words again.

props.title: Notely
props.subtitle: One calm place for everything you want to remember

beats.narration: Using it is simple. First, capture the thought. Second, organize it. Third, search whenever you need it. That is the whole idea.

steps.label: Capture
steps.detail: Write the thought the moment it appears

steps.label: Organize
steps.detail: Add a tag or drop it in a folder

beats.narration: Capture is quick. Open the app and start typing. Your idea lands on the page before it has a chance to slip away.

props.alt: hands typing notes on a computer

beats.narration: Organizing stays light. Add tags to group related thoughts, or place notes in folders if you like order.
Then comes search. Type a word you remember, and Notely finds the note right away. You don't need to recall where you put it. Just remember a little of what you wrote.

props.text: Remember a word, and find the whole thought.

beats.narration: Notely works the way you do. On your phone while you walk, on your laptop at your desk, or on a tablet on the couch. Your notes are waiting wherever you are.
Imagine your next big idea. A plan for a trip, a project at work, a story you want to write. Notely gives all of it a home, and keeps it close.

props.clip_query: person planning at desk with coffee
clip_queries: person planning at desk with coffee
woman working on laptop at home

beats.narration: Stop losing your best thinking. Download Notely today, write your first note, and give your ideas a place where they never get lost.

props.text: Download Notely today. Give your ideas a home.
